Third-party files served with the Git Panel UI (no network access at run time)

highlight-11.9.0.min.js
  highlight.js 11.9.0 (common languages build), from
  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/highlight.min.js, unmodified.
  BSD 3-Clause License, see highlight-LICENSE.txt (from the 11.9.0 tag of github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js).

file-icons.js
  The file icon maps (the Seti theme of VS Code: file name / extension -> glyph and color), copied from the
  approved prototype (its js/data-ikon.js); only the global's name changed (window.FileIconMaps).
  The Seti glyph font is ../img/file-icons/seti.woff; both come from vscode's seti-ui theme, MIT License,
  see ../img/file-icons/SETI-LICENSE.txt.

../css/tokens.css
  The default skin's color and size tokens, from the prototype (the owner's own design); comments rewritten.

../git/icons/*.svg, ../git/icons.js
  IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition icons, Apache License 2.0: see ../git/NOTICE.txt.
